vpp.title: [provider architecture] Make declared AProvider inference configuration effective and observable
vpp.validation_resource_profile: local CPU and loopback wire capture; no provider credentials, cloud, model download, or paid calls
vpp.validation_size_split: focused component tests first; component-wide test only if focused proof or CI requires it
vpp.expected_proof_cost: bounded local Rust compile and test
vpp.issue_goal_ref: Active issue #970 implementation, native proof, independent review, and draft publication goal
vpp.selected_lanes_inline: provider normalization and rejection; Ollama HTTP wire capture; profile/reload/direct parity; documentation and diff hygiene; independent exact-head review
vpp.parallel_groups_inline: Run independent focused Rust test filters sequentially against one warmed target; docs and diff checks may follow without provider execution.
vpp.validation_commands_inline: .csdlc/evidence/970/validate.sh for full local proof; native proof runs cargo test --manifest-path adl-provider-core/Cargo.toml
vpp.failure_policy: Fail closed on any ignored supplied control, executable authority field, pre-dispatch I/O in negative tests, unstable fingerprint, private-data leakage, profile/direct mismatch, zero-test result, live-provider dependency, or unresolved review finding.
vpp.plan_summary: Prove the canonical effective configuration and selected-codec consumption boundary with deterministic local component tests and loopback wire capture.
vpp.notes_risks_inline: Runtime and direct paths must converge through the same factory; if a codec cannot consume an explicitly supplied normalized control, admission must reject it before network or process execution.
